query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.studentcourses
query.description: Transcript and in-progress courses for myBlueprint (StudentCourses.txt format)
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS school_ids ,'F1,S1,S2,Y1' AS store_codes ,7 AS min_student_grade ,8 AS min_course_grade ,1 AS accept_exclude_from_gpa FROM dual ), yr AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) - CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM')) < 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - 1990 AS yearid FROM dual ), stored AS ( SELECT s.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number ,sg.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number ,sg.COURSE_NAME AS course_name ,t.LASTDAY AS lastday ,sgrx.CREDIT_DATE AS credit_date ,COALESCE(TO_CHAR(sg.AB_FINAL_MARK), sg.GRADE) AS mark ,sg.EARNEDCRHRS AS earned ,sg.POTENTIALCRHRS AS potential ,CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS credit_hours ,c.MAXCREDIT AS maxcredit ,PS_CUSTOMFIELDS.GETCF('Courses', c.ID, 'alt_course_number') AS alt_course_number ,c.CODE AS code ,sg.CREDIT_TYPE AS credit_type ,sg.GRADE AS grade_sort ,1 AS src FROM STOREDGRADES sg LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 INNER JOIN STUDENTS s ON sg.STUDENTID = s.ID AND s.GRADE_LEVEL >= cfg.min_student_grade INNER JOIN TERMS t ON t.ID = sg.TERMID AND t.SCHOOLID = sg.SCHOOLID INNER JOIN COURSES c ON sg.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN S_ON_SGR_X sgrx ON sg.DCID = sgrx.STOREDGRADESDCID WHERE sg.GRADE_LEVEL >= cfg.min_course_grade AND INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.store_codes, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || sg.STORECODE || ',') > 0 AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || s.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) AND s.ENROLL_STATUS IN (-1, 0) AND ((sg.COURSE_NUMBER LIKE 'PLE%' AND sg.EARNEDCRHRS > 0) OR sg.COURSE_NUMBER NOT LIKE 'PLE%') AND (NVL(sg.EXCLUDEFROMGPA, 0) = 0 OR cfg.accept_exclude_from_gpa = 1) AND (sg.POTENTIALCRHRS > 0 OR sg.EARNEDCRHRS > 0) ), current_cc AS ( SELECT s.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number ,cc.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number ,c.COURSE_NAME AS course_name ,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS lastday ,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS credit_date ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS mark ,CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS earned ,CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS potential ,c.CREDIT_HOURS AS credit_hours ,c.MAXCREDIT AS maxcredit ,PS_CUSTOMFIELDS.GETCF('Courses', c.ID, 'alt_course_number') AS alt_course_number ,c.CODE AS code ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS credit_type ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS grade_sort ,2 AS src FROM CC cc LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN yr ON 1=1 INNER JOIN COURSES c ON cc.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE_NUMBER INNER JOIN TERMS t ON t.ID = cc.TERMID AND t.YEARID = yr.yearid AND t.SCHOOLID = cc.SCHOOLID INNER JOIN STUDENTS s ON cc.STUDENTID = s.ID AND s.GRADE_LEVEL >= cfg.min_student_grade AND s.ENROLL_STATUS IN (0, -1) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM STOREDGRADES sg2 WHERE sg2.STUDENTID = cc.STUDENTID AND sg2.COURSE_NUMBER = cc.COURSE_NUMBER AND sg2.SECTIONID = cc.SECTIONID AND (sg2.POTENTIALCRHRS > 0 OR sg2.EARNEDCRHRS > 0) ) AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || s.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) ), combined AS ( SELECT student_number, course_number, course_name, lastday, credit_date, mark, earned, potential, credit_hours, maxcredit, alt_course_number, code, credit_type, grade_sort, src FROM stored UNION ALL SELECT student_number, course_number, course_name, lastday, credit_date, mark, earned, potential, credit_hours, maxcredit, alt_course_number, code, credit_type, grade_sort, src FROM current_cc ), ranked AS ( SELECT x.student_number ,x.course_number ,x.course_name ,x.lastday ,x.mark ,x.earned ,x.potential ,x.credit_hours ,x.maxcredit ,x.alt_course_number ,x.code ,x.credit_type ,NVL(x.credit_date, x.lastday) AS dt ,CASE WHEN x.course_number LIKE 'PLE%' THEN 1 ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.student_number, x.course_number, x.lastday ORDER BY NVL(x.earned, -1) DESC, x.src, NVL(x.grade_sort, ' ') DESC) END AS rn FROM combined x WHERE x.course_number IS NOT NULL ), codes AS ( SELECT r.student_number ,r.course_number ,r.course_name ,r.lastday ,r.mark ,r.credit_type ,r.dt ,r.course_number AS out_course_code ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS out_alt_code ,CASE WHEN r.dt IS NOT NULL AND r.dt <= SYSDATE THEN r.earned WHEN NVL(NVL(r.credit_hours, r.potential), 0) <= 0.001 AND r.maxcredit > 0 THEN r.maxcredit ELSE NVL(r.credit_hours, r.potential) END AS credit_value FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(x.student_number) AS a_StudentID ,x.out_course_code AS b_CourseCode ,TRIM(TRANSLATE(x.course_name, '|' || CHR(9) || CHR(10) || CHR(13), ' ')) AS c_CourseName ,TO_CHAR(x.dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d_DateCompleted ,TRIM(x.mark) AS e_FinalMark ,RTRIM(TO_CHAR(x.credit_value, 'FM9990.999'), '.') AS f_Credit ,x.out_alt_code AS g_AlternateCourseCode ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS h_CourseID ,CASE WHEN x.course_number LIKE 'PLE%' THEN x.credit_type END AS i_SubstituteID FROM codes x ORDER BY x.student_number, NVL(x.lastday, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) DESC, x.course_number
